QUOTE: "The deny list is checked later, at execution, and is the only list that can stop a call that was already approved." and "7. deny-list match → "Error: Permission denied for <tool>"" under ServerManager::execute; also "With a callback registered, the only way a call is refused is the deny list."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the deny list is checked in ServerManager::execute and is the only list that blocks, with the allow list only skipping the approval prompt.
